title: Zoho Analytics 7.0: Ask Zia AI Agents + Connect Claude Desktop (2026)
chapters: Cost, timing and what to do next

sources.name: Zoho press release 10 Nov 2026 via Vietnam Investment Review

description:
Zoho Analytics 7.0 turns Analytics into an agentic platform: Ask Zia, a super agent that routes your question to six specialist agents, a built-in semantic layer and ontology for business context, 30+ new connectors, an MCP server, a CLI and a connector for Claude Desktop. In this video: what Zoho announced on 10 Nov 2026, what each agent does, how context and governance work, how to connect Claude Desktop step by step (Settings > Integrations > Zoho Analytics MCP Server > Add to Claude > credentials > Install), and what it costs and when it arrives.

beats.text: Zoho Analytics becomes an agentic analytics platform

beats.label: specialist AI agents inside Ask Zia

beats.text: Ask your data, in plain English

lines: Zoho Analytics can now answer business questions with a team of six A I agents, and you can even plug it into Claude.
On the tenth of November twenty twenty-six, Zoho announced Analytics seven point zero, which it calls an agentic analytics platform.
You ask in plain English. A super agent called Ask Zia picks the right specialist to answer.
In this video: what is new, what each agent does, how Zoho gives the A I your business meaning, how to connect Claude Desktop step by step, and what it costs.
Chapter one. What Zoho announced.
Until now, you built reports and dashboards yourself, or asked an analyst.
Now Ask Zia is a conversational layer on top of your data. You ask a question, and the agents do the work.
That can mean analysis, charts, data preparation, even S Q L and code, all from the chat.
Zoho says the release brings more than fifty new capabilities.
That includes more than thirty new data connectors, added to over five hundred that already existed, and six specialist agents behind Ask Zia.
On the Zoho side, there are new connectors for Zoho E R P, Zoho Spend, and Zoho F S M.
Also Zoho Shifts and Zoho Voice.
Outside Zoho, you get S A P, PayPal, and Twilio.
And Notion, Intercom, and Supabase, among others.
Agentic means more than answering questions. Zoho says agents can trigger actions and workflows directly.
Those workflows can be designed in a workflow builder, and agents can be shared across teams with governance and observability controls.
So an answer can turn into an action, with a record of what the agent did.
The release is not only about agents. Zoho lists more than ten new visualizations, plus custom visuals.
Pixel-perfect reports, for layouts that must look exactly right.
New predictive tools: scenario analysis, a correlation matrix, and a forecasting model called V A R X.
A data science studio with Jupyter notebooks.
And Ask Zia now works on mobile, with an upgraded interface.
Chapter two. Meet the Ask Zia agents.

visual.title: How Ask Zia works
visual.footer: A central agent plans and coordinates

lines: Here is the flow. You ask a question. Ask Zia, the super agent, plans how to answer it.
It hands the work to specialist agents, which share the same business context and the same conversation.
Then you get the answer in the chat.
Zoho's what's new page lists six specialists.
A data analysis agent, for questions about your numbers.
A visualization agent, for charts.
A data prep agent, for cleaning and shaping data.
A formula agent, for calculations.
And an S Q L agent and a coding agent, for the technical work.
Ask Zia remembers your conversation history, so follow-up questions work.
And you can use Zia's own language model, or bring your own frontier model.
You are not limited to the built-in agents. Teams can build custom agents around their own data and workflows.
Custom agents can use M C P servers and web search, and there is a gallery of pre-built agents to start from.
Zoho also lets organizations embed these agents in their own apps, portals and products, with white labeling.
Permissions and governance rules still apply wherever the agent runs, which matters if clients will see it.
Chapter three. Giving the AI business context.

visual.title: Two layers of context
visual.footer: Built in, no separate data warehouse needed

lines: The hard part of A I analytics is meaning. What does revenue mean in your company?
Zoho built a semantic layer into Analytics. It is a business glossary for the A I, with descriptions, synonyms, instructions and metrics.
On top sits an ontology, which models your business entities and how they relate to each other.
Zoho says both are built in, and you can edit them without code.
For example, if people say revenue, sales and turnover, you can tell the A I they mean the same metric.
Define it once, and every agent uses the same definition.
Zoho also added oversight tools. A data catalog covers your data, metrics and models, with lineage.
A I observability shows which agents ran, who used them, what they accessed, and how they answered.
It also tracks A I usage and cost by team.
And a sandbox lets you test first, publish to production, and roll back if needed.
Zoho also shared a roadmap, with no dates. First, dynamic business context, which tracks how your data changes over time.
Decision intelligence, which learns from the outcomes of actions that agents trigger.
More openness. The semantic models are already compatible with the Apache Ossie specification, so definitions stay portable.
And a full unified data platform, with a data lakehouse and agent building in one place.
Chapter four. Connect Claude Desktop.

visual.title: Three ways to reach Analytics from Claude

lines: Zoho gives you three ways to reach Analytics from Claude.
The easiest is the Claude Desktop connector, installed from the Claude marketplace.
There is also a plug-in for the Claude command line, and the M C P server itself, as a remote or local setup.

visual.title: Before you start
visual.footer: Sign in to Claude Desktop first

lines: First, the requirements. You need the Claude Desktop app, not the web version, on Mac or Windows.
Sign in to Claude Desktop with your Anthropic account.
Then, in the Zoho Developer Console, create a Self Client application and enable the Zoho Analytics scope.
Generate a refresh token. You will paste it into the connector.
The connector asks for your O Auth client I D and client secret.
Your refresh token.
Your Zoho Analytics organization I D.
And the two server addresses, for the data center where your Zoho account was created.
Zoho lists U S, E U, I N, A U, J P and C A, so pick the one that matches your account.

visual.title: Install the connector
visual.footer: Then check it shows as active

lines: Now install it. In Claude Desktop, open Settings, then the Integrations tab.
Click Add Integration, or browse the Claude marketplace, and find the Zoho Analytics M C P Server.
Click Add to Claude, enter your credential values in the dialog, and click Install.
Claude Desktop validates the credentials and registers the server. It should now show as active under Settings, Integrations.
Now you can ask Claude questions about your Analytics workspaces.
One thing to know: Zoho's documentation says the data gathered for a request is shared with the language model to produce the answer.
Every request uses A P I units, depending on which A P Is are called to build the answer.
And Zoho notes the M C P server is still in development, so its tools may change. Try it on non-sensitive data first.
Once connected, you might ask Claude things like: which five customers brought the most revenue this year?
Or: show me monthly sales as a chart. These are only illustrations. What works depends on your data, your permissions and the tools available in your account.

visual.title: Cost, timing and what to do next

lines: Chapter five. Cost, timing and what to do next.
Now the money. Zoho says pricing is unchanged, and Zoho L L M credits are now included in each plan.
The cloud updates are available now.
Previews of pixel-perfect reporting, the ontology and the semantic model roll out globally over the next four to eight weeks.
On-premise customers get the update in the first quarter of twenty twenty-seven.
Check Zoho's pricing page for the plan and region you use.

visual.title: Your next steps
items: Try Ask Zia on test data

lines: So what should you do? Open the what's new page and see which features reached your account.
List your five key metrics, and define them clearly, because context is what makes A I answers trustworthy.
Try Ask Zia on a test workspace first, and add the Claude connector only if you need it.
Then decide who on your team may use the agents, because the new oversight tools only help if someone looks at them.
Your data is now one question away.

visual.note: Features roll out in phases: check Zoho's docs

lines: If this helped, subscribe for more Zoho and A I news and tutorials.
And features roll out in phases, so always check Zoho's latest documentation for your account.
